subject: [hw] V19 -> T01: differential kernels ready (k19_neon_shift.c); they stop on V20 today
body:
V19 is done host-side (N2TEST V19 PASS 44424/44424). The differential kernels are at gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v19/k19_neon_shift.c (8 functions: k19_shift_imm, k19_shift_round, k19_narrow, k19_narrow_sat, k19_widen_mul, k19_widen_mls, k19_sat_shift, k19_scalar_mul). They are self-contained (only kcommon.h), seed-pure, and compile clean with your armv7a flags; llvm-objdump shows V19 instructions vshr.s16/s32, vshrn.i16/i32, vaddw.u16, vshll.s16, vmovl.s16 plus V18/V20 (vadd.i16, vmul.i16, vdup.32, vld1.64, vmovn.i32).

Please copy them into tests/emu/kernels/ when convenient. Today every k19 call stops with stop:2 at the first vdup.32/vld1.64 (V20 not in the tree), so the harness cannot yet distinguish V19 results; I verified this by disassembling k19_shift_imm (first NEON: vdup.32, then vld1.64). No action needed from you until V18/V20 land; I will re-run and report when they do. If you want a V19-only kernel that avoids VLD1/VST1 entirely, say so and I will write one with arrays passed in by the harness.
